newsitem.title: USA: Imo ends deal with United Dominion.
newsitem.headline: Imo ends deal with United Dominion.

text.p: Imo Industries Inc said late Friday that it has terminated its merger agreement with United Dominion Industries Ltd to accept a better offer from II Acquisition Corp, an affiliate of Constellation Capital Partners LLC.
While United Dominion had offered $6 a share, Imo said it has a definitive agreement with II Acquisition for $7.05 a share, net in cash.
Earlier on Friday, Imo's board of directors unanimously determined that the II Acquisition Corp offer was on terms more favorable to its stockholders, Imo said.
Imo said its board terminated the United Dominion deal and approved II Acquisition's tender offer.
United Dominion officials were not immediately available for comment.
Under the terms of its prior deal with United Dominion, Imo said $8 million is being paid to United Dominion and United Dominion will be reimbursed for up to $2 million of its expenses incurred.
Unlike the United Dominion agreement, the II Acquisition agreement does not contemplate an offer to purchase Imo's 11-3/4 percent Senior Subordinated Notes due 2006.

II Acquisition's tender offer for the shares of Imo common stock is conditioned on the receipt of more than 80 percent of the outstanding shares, it said. Any shares not purchased in the tender offer will remain outstanding.

"Acquisition Corp's offer of $7.05 per share exceeds United Dominion's offer by more than 17 percent and does not include any financing condition," Imo Chairman and Chief Executive Donald Farrar said in a statement. "Imo's Board of Directors believes Acquisition Corp's offer will provide Imo's stockholders better value than United Dominion's offer."
Imo said that II Acquisition will commence its tender offer for all its common stock on or before August 1.
If United Dominion elects to terminate its offer, it is required to promptly return any shares tendered, Imo said.
Imo is a diversified manufacturer of pumps, fluid sensors, motion control products, remote control systems, and automobile components.
Constellation Capital is a private equity firm based in Richmond, Va.
